text:
Raj: quick Q — where can I get a heatmap of SM% across GPU pools over the last 24h? need to correlate with KV cache evictions and per-batch throughput.
Nina: theres a panel in the grafana folder but its a bit buried: /dashboards/eng-runtime/gpu-ops -> 'SM% by pool (heatmap)'. does that help? :eyes:
Raj: thanks — any chance that panel also exposes the batch-size dimension? I'm trying to see p50/p95 latency vs batch size buckets.
Eve: the heatmap is SM% by slab + time. for batch-size correlation, use the timeseries panel on 'inference.batch_size' with a group_by(bucket) and overlay p95 latency.
Kai: if you want a single query to export pairs, try this grafana PromQL: 
```
sum by(pool, batch_bucket) (rate(gpu_sm_busy_seconds_total[5m])) / sum by(pool) (machine_gpu_count)
```
then join with: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool, batch_bucket))
```
Raj: perfect — any pointer for KV cache eviction rates? I want 'evictions per 1k requests' per pool.
Nina: metric is runtime.kvcache.evictions_total. divide by request rate: 
```
1000 * sum(rate(runtime_kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total[5m])) by (pool)
```
Liya (pm): heads-up — product noticed a latency spike this morning in prod-c, might be related. if we tune alerts, I'd prefer to avoid noisy paging. can we propose a pilot: alert when evictions per-1k > 5 AND sm% > 85% for 10m?
Eve: pragmatic. propose an alert rule like this (prometheus alert):
```
- alert: HighGPUPressureWithEvictions
  expr: (
    (1000 * sum(rate(runtime_kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total[5m])) by (pool)) > 5
  ) and (
    avg_over_time(sum(rate(gpu_sm_busy_seconds_total[1m])) by (pool) [10m:]) / sum(machine_gpu_count) by (pool) > 0.85
  )
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "High GPU SM% and KV evictions in {{ $labels.pool }}"
```
Raj: that looks good. can we run it in a staging alerting group for a week and route to #eng-oncall first? no paging unless both conditions hold for 15m.
Kai: I can put a draft PR in infra-alerts, tag it as 'staging-first', set for 15m. will also add a playbook link.
InfraBot: created alert draft: https://alerts.internal/repo/infra-alerts/pulls/72 by Kai — staging target set. :robot_face:
Nina: also, for traces — grab a trace sample from jaeger tag 'pool=<pool>' and operation 'generate'. that will show KV cache miss patterns and tail latency.
Raj: thanks everyone — I'll collect queries and put a short runbook in the gpu-ops readme. pinging if you notice noise after PR lands. :thumbsup:
